fact: Posts and Telecommunications Minister Sekou Kromah said the government has begun rolling out a national digital postal address system across all fifteen counties.

The Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications' Strategic Plan 2025-2029, Digital Liberia, lists introducing a national digital addressing system alongside postal reform among its eight priority focus areas.
